name: PageCore – Designer-Made Starter Sites for the Block Editor
author: Mahesh Patel

sections.description:
Your next website is already built.

Pick one of 28 complete websites, each designed for a kind of business: a law firm, a clinic, a restaurant, a construction company, an agency and more. Import it with a guided wizard, and its pages, photos, menus, header, footer, contact form, colours and fonts arrive together. Then add your own words and photos in the WordPress Site Editor you already know.

Everything is made of WordPress’s own blocks (Gutenberg), so there is no page builder to learn, pay for or get stuck with.

28 starter sites · 180 pages · 137 sections · 27 styles · photos included

See all 28 live | Website | Help | Support forum

Who makes it

  • Designed by a theme designer. Mahesh Patel has made WordPress themes for 16+ years: 14 themes on ThemeForest with 14,000+ sales, and the PageCore FSE theme on WordPress.org. Every starter site is checked on phones, tablets and desktops.
  • Measured for speed. On 8 November 2026, the home pages of all 28 starter sites scored 95–99 on phones in Lighthouse, the test inside Google’s PageSpeed Insights. How we tested

What you can do

  • Start finished. Import a whole website, not a single template. The wizard shows what will come in before anything starts.
  • Change a section’s design. Select a section, choose Change design and pick another design of the same kind. It keeps your colours and fonts and brings sample text to replace. One Undo takes you back.
  • Add ready-made sections. Open the PageCore Library in the editor and add a hero, services, team, pricing or testimonials section, or a whole page from any starter site.
  • Restyle the whole site. One of 27 styles changes colours, fonts and spacing everywhere at once. Your content stays as it is.

See a few live

  • Business Consulting
  • Law Firm
  • Medical Clinic
  • Restaurant & Café
  • Construction
  • Photography Studio

What you need

  • WordPress 7.0 or newer.
  • The PageCore FSE theme for complete starter sites. It is on WordPress.org, and the wizard installs it for you.
  • WPForms Lite for the contact forms, if you want them. The wizard offers to install it.

Source code

The plugin includes the readable source code of its compiled JavaScript.

External services

PageCore downloads starter sites, designs, styles and fonts from PageCore’s servers when you use those features, and shows their preview images from there. These requests include the file being requested and the PageCore version; when your browser shows a preview image, it sends its usual information, such as your IP address.

Terms of service: https://pagecore.net/terms/
Privacy policy: https://pagecore.net/privacy/

The PageCore FSE theme, and WPForms Lite when a starter site’s contact form needs it, are installed from WordPress.org by WordPress itself. Privacy policy: https://wordpress.org/about/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin and search for PageCore.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Go to PageCore > Starter Sites, choose a design and click Import. The wizard guides you through the rest, including installing the PageCore FSE theme.
  4. To add single sections, open any page in the editor and click the PageCore Library button.

Step-by-step help with pictures: https://pagecore.net/help/
sections.faq:
Which theme does PageCore need? Will it work with my theme?

Complete starter sites are designed for the PageCore FSE theme. If it is missing, the wizard installs it from WordPress.org and activates it, after telling you. The Design Library also works with other block themes, but spacing and colours can look different from the previews, and the section colour styles are switched off. The Style Library appears only with PageCore FSE.

Can I import a starter site into a site that already has content?

Yes. Your own pages, posts and forms stay. Before anything starts, the wizard lists what will be imported, including the front page, site title, permalinks and the site’s colours and fonts. A site holds one starter site at a time, so importing a new one replaces the one already there, and the wizard asks you to agree first. A finished import can’t be undone in one click, so back up a site that has work you want to keep.

Can I use PageCore and its photos on client websites?

Yes, on as many of your own and your clients’ websites as you like, for personal and commercial projects. The photos were made with AI for PageCore. You can use them on any site where PageCore is active, and keep them there if you switch it off later. You may not resell them, for example as stock photos or inside a theme or template. Details: Terms of use.

Do I need WPForms?

Only for the contact forms. Starter sites with a contact page use WPForms Lite from WordPress.org. The wizard offers to install it; untick the box and the site is imported without its form.

Will PageCore slow down my website?

On your public pages, PageCore adds only small style sheets (about 6 KB at most) and no JavaScript. The import and the libraries work in the admin area, and imported photos are stored in your own media library. The 28 starter sites’ home pages scored 95–99 on phones in Lighthouse 12.8.2 on 8 November 2026. How we tested

What happens if I switch PageCore off?

Your pages are ordinary blocks and stay in place, with their photos. Some sections use PageCore’s colour schemes (Soft, Accent, Dark), and some blocks use its Tablet Navigation or Absolute Position options; with PageCore off, those parts lose that styling. So keep PageCore active on a site built with it.

Can I add a single page or section instead of a whole website?

Yes. In the editor, open the PageCore Library: Patterns has single sections, and Site Kits has every page of every starter site. Their images are copied to your media library. Nothing else is imported.

Do I need coding skills or an account?

No. You choose a starter site, follow the four-step wizard, and change text, images and layout with blocks. There is nothing to sign up for and no licence key. The External services section lists what PageCore connects to.

Does it work on WordPress multisite?

Yes. Each site in the network imports its own starter site and keeps its own styles and settings.

Where can I get help?

Step-by-step guides are on https://pagecore.net/help/. For questions, use the PageCore support forum on WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Improved: The import wizard’s second step is shorter and fits on the screen without scrolling.
  • Improved: The Import button shows that it is working while an import starts.
  • Improved: If the connection drops while an import starts, the wizard says so and lets you try again.
  • Improved: The finish screen shows its next steps as buttons, with a link to review PageCore on WordPress.org.
  • Improved: The Design Library tries a starter site again by itself when the connection drops for a moment, before it shows a warning.
  • Fixed: Right after a starter site import, My Styles no longer says you changed the editor styles yourself. It says the design came with the starter site.

1.0.1

  • New: 22 more starter sites, each with its own matching style in the Style Library.
  • New: Change design. Swap a section for another Design Library design of the same kind, right from the block’s settings.
  • New: Every style includes photo fades (Photo Fade Bottom, Photo Fade Left and Section Fade Left) that keep text on photos readable.
  • New: Each style in the Style Library has a Preview of a starter site that uses it.
  • New: The Style Library asks before you switch between a light and a dark style.
  • New: On a multisite network, site admins are told before an import when some design effects need the network admin.
  • Improved: All styles use the theme’s page side spacing, outline buttons, column gaps and links.
  • Improved: A starter site’s style is still applied after the style has been updated.
  • Improved: Text sizes that a style sets as fixed stay fixed on phones.
  • Improved: An icon that contains script is left out of an import, and the finish screen says so.
  • Improved: More space between the Starter Sites cards.
  • Fixed: Smaller copies of a starter site’s photos now point to your own media library after an import.
  • Fixed: Image addresses inside a block’s Additional CSS now point to your site after an import.
  • Fixed: Design Library previews follow a Style Library switch straight away.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
